base_directory.title: Allowed folder
base_directory.description: The folder Nitro PDF Services is allowed to read files from and write files to, including its subfolders. All file operations are restricted to this folder. Leave empty to allow your home folder.

tools.name: list_files
tools.description: Lists files on the local filesystem available for PDF processing, optionally filtered by file type.

tools.name: convert_file
tools.description:
Converts a file between supported formats.
The following conversions are supported:
Convert from a pdf to docx, jpeg, pdfa, png, pptx, xlsx.
Convert from a csv, doc, docm, docx, dotm, dotx, eps, gif, html, jpeg, png, ppt, pptx, psd, rtf, svg, tiff, txt, xls, xlsm, xlsx, xltm, xltx, xml to pdf.

tools.name: get_pdf_metadata
tools.description: Retrieves the metadata of a PDF file.

tools.name: extract_pdf_forms
tools.description: Extracts form fields from a PDF file.

tools.name: smart_detect_form_fields
tools.description: Automatically detects form fields in a PDF file. Returns the detected form-field bounding boxes as JSON.

tools.name: extract_fillable_form_data
tools.description: Extracts the existing AcroForm field data — field names, values, types and positions — from a fillable PDF (AcroForm only, not XFA), useful for inspecting a form or reading back data someone entered. Returns a flat formFields list as JSON; the name/value pairs can be used directly as input to fill_forms.

tools.name: extract_pdf_tables
tools.description: Extracts tables from a PDF file.

tools.name: extract_pdf_text
tools.description: Extracts text from a PDF file.

tools.name: extract_invoice_data
tools.description: Extracts structured invoice or expense data from a PDF, such as vendor details, line items, totals, and dates.

tools.name: search_text_in_pdf
tools.description: Searches a PDF for text and returns the location of each match, using literal text or regular expression queries. Returns a bounding box for each match as absolute [x, y, width, height] values in PDF points (origin at the page corner), the same [x0, y0, width, height] convention that redact_pdf accepts, so matches can be passed straight into a redaction. By default (outputTarget set to inline) the matches are returned directly in the result; set outputTarget to file or both to also write them to a JSON file on disk.

tools.name: fill_forms
tools.description: Fills in form fields in a PDF document with the provided field values. Field values may be supplied inline or via a CSV, JSON, XFDF, or FDF data file.

tools.name: create_fillable_forms
tools.description: Generates a new PDF containing the provided form fields as real, fillable AcroForm fields. The fields are typically the formFields returned by the smart_detect_form_fields tool.

tools.name: extract_pii
tools.description: Extracts PII (Personally Identifiable Information) from a PDF file. Returns detected PII entities, bounding boxes, and confidence scores. By default (outputTarget set to inline) the detections are returned directly in the result; set outputTarget to file or both to also write them to a JSON file on disk.

tools.name: redact_pdf
tools.description: Redacts a PDF file. Accepts either (1) a piiJsonFile path (output from extract_pii) to automatically redact all detected PII, or (2) manual redactions with page indices and bounding box coordinates. Each manual redaction may include an optional label, rendered onto the black box in the output (e.g. "Redacted" or the PII type). Applies the redactions and saves a redacted PDF.

tools.name: render_pdf_page
tools.description: Renders a single PDF page (or a clipped region of it) as an inline PNG image, returned directly in the tool result with no file written to disk. Useful for visually verifying redactions, inspecting layout near a detected PII box, or any case where the model needs to see what a page actually looks like.

tools.name: merge_files
tools.description: Merges multiple PDF files into a single PDF. By default, PDF bookmarks (an outline entry per source document, with each existing bookmark from that document nested beneath) are added to the merged file; set tableOfContents to false to skip them. No extra table-of-contents page is added and the page count is unchanged.

tools.name: split_pdf
tools.description: Splits a PDF into separate files by page ranges.

tools.name: rotate_pdf
tools.description: Rotates specific pages in a PDF file.

tools.name: protect_pdf
tools.description: Password-protects a PDF file with optional permissions.

tools.name: unprotect_pdf
tools.description: Removes password protection from a PDF file.

tools.name: delete_pdf_pages
tools.description: Deletes specific pages from a PDF file.

tools.name: set_pdf_metadata
tools.description: Sets or updates metadata properties of a PDF file.

tools.name: flatten_pdf
tools.description: Flattens a PDF, converting all interactive form fields and annotations into static, non-editable content.

tools.name: watermark_pdf
tools.description: Adds an image watermark to a PDF file.

tools.name: ocr_pdf
tools.description: Applies OCR to a PDF file, producing a searchable or editable PDF.

tools.name: optimize_pdf
tools.description: Optimizes a PDF file for a specific use case.

tools.name: compress_pdf
tools.description: Compresses a PDF to always produce the smallest possible file — a special case of optimization that always minimizes file size, with no control over the size/quality trade-off (see optimize_pdf and its profile option for that).
